sloka: बहूनि च करोति स्म दृश्यन्ते न त्वसौ ततः ।प्रतिगृह्य ततो राम महदस्त्रं दशाननः ।। ७.१५.३४ ॥
transliteration: bahūni ca karoti sma dṛśyante na tvasau tataḥ ।pratigṛhya tato rāma mahadastraṁ daśānanaḥ ।। 7.15.34 ॥

translations.english: Ravana, having received a great weapon, was performing many actions, but he himself was not visible.
